caption_L2L3: Colston got the most yards at nearly 10,000. The people that got the least yards are Hilliard, Parks and Haynes. Most Orleans saints got 4,000 yard or less. Most of them received less than half the yards of the highest receiver. The second most yards received was by Martin.
